description: Send feedback to the SocialAPI team. Use when a user wants to report a bug, request a feature, or share general feedback. Type must be one of: 'bug', 'feature_request', or 'general'. The feedback is stored in the database and the team is notified. This is the preferred way to reach the team from within an MCP conversation.

type.description: Feedback type: bug, feature_request, or general

name: social_api_send_feedback
title: Send Feedback
